resources.string: Jump between your computer’s desktops from the Apps panel, add a display of the phone’s shape, and close or minimise a window with a long press.
Commands and files in the composer
Type a slash for commands and skills, or an at sign to mention a file. Review every changed file across your chats in one place.
Changed files wait on the Agents page until you have looked at them, and a finished turn offers its next step as a button.
Send a wake packet to a sleeping computer on your network from its menu on the Connect page.
